Triage: lands in `domain:server` (runtime `HttpDispatcher` host doors for `plugin-auth` personal views and `service-storage` attachments) · `pm:queue`; rationale: area:cloud (a problem that appears only on hosted tenant kernels; by the North Star boundary it goes to cloud in place of its product area) · Bug · `DELETE /api/v1/personal-views/:id` and `DELETE` / `PATCH /api/v1/attachments/:id` are mounted only on the kernel's own `http.server`, which a hosted tenant kernel lacks, and the dispatcher has no domain for those paths. So on hosted they fall through to 404 `ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`: users cannot delete a personal view or remove or rename an attachment. Read from code with the mechanism named (`git grep` shows 0 dispatcher hits on main c9b0a2305); a read-from-code finding grades like a measured one. Same class as #36469 (p1) and ruling 6079645593. A common function that errors → **p1** (seat suggested p2) · size S. On request from repo:objectstack#2 (#32588 comment 7081398663).
